caption: The drawing depicts a wooden mantel clock with a rectangular base and a rounded top. The clock is rendered in brown tones to simulate a wood grain texture, with darker and lighter variations to indicate the grain and the contours of the wood. The top section of the clock features a large, round clock face with black Roman numerals and black clock hands, indicating the time. Below the main clock face, there is a rectangular nameplate, and beneath this, a larger circular calendar dial. The calendar dial is cream-colored with black numbers around its circumference, marking the dates from 1 to 31. Within the calendar dial are two windows: one showing the day of the week (indicating "SATURDAY") and another showing the month (indicating "JANUARY"). Text above the center of the calendar dial reads "A.B. Horton’s Patents" and "Ithaca Calendar Clock Co." along with the company's location, "Ithaca, N.Y." In the upper portion of this dial, there is a decorative monogram with the letters “IC.” The overall composition is symmetrical, and the drawing is detailed, emphasizing the clock's wood texture, hardware, and dials. The background is plain and off-white, containing no additional objects or decorations. The artist’s name, Grace Halatin, appears in the lower right corner.
title: Clock
